quantity: steady mass flow rate W [kg/s] through a centred circular orifice in a flat-bottom silo

source.authors: Beverloo, W. A.; Leniger, H. A.; van de Velde, J.
source.title: The flow of granular solids through orifices
source.equation_location: correlation W = C rho_b g^(1/2) (D - k d)^(5/2); the coefficient pair for spherical particles is Eq. (4), p. 265

coefficients.applicability: spherical particles, flat-bottom (or shallow hopper) silo, smooth walls, D/d >~ 4, free gravity discharge

provenance.retrieved_how: read from the published correlation as documented in this repository (src/tensordem/silo_discharge.py docstring, benchmarks/beverloo_hopper_m15259.py header and prereg/m15259_beverloo.md, all citing Eq. (4) of the 1961 paper)
provenance.verification_status: cited, NOT re-digitized: no copy of the 1961 paper and no outbound network in this worktree, so the original table/points could not be re-read programmatically
provenance.friction_note: zero-hand-copy rule cannot be fully met for the *original table*; the *coefficient pair* is machine-read from this file by the case scripts, and the residual risk is that C/k are quoted values rather than re-digitized observations
